source: generated by tools/build_drpg_evility_overlay.py from the DRPGEVIL1 census of the JP client masters leaderskill + character (Disgaea Source/Disgaea RPG JP (Android)); read by d5lib/importers/drpg_evilities.py - never recomputed at build time
id_rule: 28000 + 4 * position in drpg-leases.json bases + slot (0 main, 1-3 sub); recorded per row

decision_text.D1: field-wide scope: party -> every ally on the map (aura radius 30 + the holder's own row); all enemies -> every enemy on the map
decision_text.D2: a buff the source re-applies every turn (turn start/end, 1-3T) is read as always on
decision_text.D3: SP points (DRPG pool 0-100) read as percent of max SP at the round edge
decision_text.D4: party composition read through the source class registry (DRPGPARTY1): a potential type (King..Queen) and a favourite weapon belong to the Disgaea RPG characters and their costumes only; a D5-native or other-game ally has neither, so it receives no type-gated bonus and breaks an 'all favourite weapons different' condition
decision_text.L1: not a taste call: one live read of the battle round counter (0x145574AA8) on the first turn; 'battle start, N turns' is written as turn_max N and is right if the counter starts at 1
